thread:
sam_support: Alert — Aurora Labs onboarding blocked. Certificate upload failing at validation during provisioning. Trial expiration in 7 days; sales flagged renewal at-risk. @maria can you take this?

prod-bot: Incident INC-2027 created for cert-validation-aurora — https://redwood.incidents/INC-2027

sam_support: Error: `422 {\"error\":\"cert_validation_failed\", \"detail\": \"chain incomplete\"}` at cert-verify. Occurred ~2026-04-02T14:07Z. POC: mike.r@auroralabs.com

sam_support: Reproducer (trim):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/aurora-77/certs \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer SRV_tmp_ABC\" \
  -F \"cert=@fullchain.pem\"\n# -> 422 {\"error\":\"cert_validation_failed\",\"detail\":\"chain incomplete\"}
```

taylor_se: Likely causes: missing intermediate, chain order wrong, or SAN mismatch (they used `aurora.internal` vs `api.aurora.com`). Mitigation: ask customer to re-export fullchain with intermediates concatenated (leaf + intermediates + root). I can attempt manual upload from console with elevated token.

maria_cs: Assigning Taylor as SE lead. Jess, please stand by for live assist — this is P1 renewal-risk.

jess_enablement: I can run a 30-min hand-hold. Slots: today 16:00-17:00 PT or tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT. I'll prep a one-pager with export steps and openssl verify commands.

sam_support: Customer used Let's Encrypt via ACME client. They attached `fullchain.pem` but parser still flags incomplete. Likely chain order or missing intermediate. We need explicit re-export steps to reduce back-and-forth.

taylor_se: Requesting elevated token now to try manual upload. If we still get 422, I'll pull PEM and run `openssl verify -CAfile chain.pem cert.pem`. If it's an ACME chain quirk we can accept a temporary manually-assembled chain for onboarding tests.

prod-bot: Eng infra paged: cert-pipeline-audit requested for INC-2027.

eng-infra: Acknowledged. We'll run CA bundle validation and pipeline logs, update thread in ~45m.

sam_support: Ticket updated with repro and attached `fullchain.pem`. Waiting on SE.

maria_cs: Draft comms plan:
- Initial outreach (today): acknowledge + apology + ETA 24h + ask for re-export steps. Owner: maria_cs.
- Manual assist (if needed): SE to perform upload during scheduled session using elevated token. Owner: taylor_se & jess_enablement.
- Post-resolution: technical write-up + preventive checklist attached to renewal thread. Owner: maria_cs.

maria_cs: Suggested customer message:
\"Hi Mike — thanks for your patience. We see a certificate validation error blocking activation. We can assist with a quick re-export or perform a manual upload during a 30-min call. Can you re-export the fullchain (leaf + intermediates) or join a troubleshooting session? ETA: 24h. — Maria (CS)\"

jess_enablement: I'll draft the checklist and share a doc link here as soon as I have it.

taylor_se: Token requested. If infra finds pipeline issues, they'll remediate; else I'll proceed with manual upload.

maria_cs: Timeline: SE triage now, infra audit in ~45m, enablement scheduled within 24h, comms out today. Marking renewal as P1-risk and will update sales/renewals. Follow-up in 3 hours. :white_check_mark:
